priskribo: The high-frequency, low-content words that a text-processing pipeline usually filters out before analysing a text.
Esperanto prepositions. They govern the nominative, so the noun that follows keeps its plain `-o` / `-oj` form; the accusative after one of them marks direction, not object.
Numerals and the words used to build them. Only the cardinals are listed: the ordinals are the same words plus `-a`, and `miliono` and `miliardo` behave as ordinary nouns.
